english.title: Encourage or assist serious self-harm by another
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[communicated in person with **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) in such a way]_
(B)_[sent, transmitted or published a communication by electronic means]_
(C)_[showed to **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) a communication that had been sent, transmitted or published by electronic means]_
(D)_[published material namely **(..SPECIFY MATERIAL..) other than by electronic means]_
(E)_[sent, gave, showed or made available to**(..SPECIFY PERSON..) material published other than by electronic means]_
(F)_[sent, gave, showed or made available to **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) a form of correspondence, namely **(..SPECIFY CORRESPONDENCE..)]_
(G)_[sent, gave or made available to **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), an item on which data was stored electronically, namely**(..SPECIFY ITEM..),]_

that was capable of encouraging or assisting the serious self harm of another person with the intention that it would do so
english.legislation: Contrary to section 184 of the Online Safety Act 2023.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
communicated in person with a person OR
sent/transmitted/published a communication by electronic means OR
showed to a person a communication that had been sent/transmitted/published by electronic means OR
published material other than by electronic means OR
sent/gave/showed/made available to a person material published other than by electronic means OR
sent/gave/showed/made available to a person a form of correspondence OR
sent/gave/made available to a person an item on which data was stored electronically
in such a way that was capable of encouraging/assisting the serious self harm of another person
with the intention that it would do so

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Serious self-harm means self-harm amounting to, in England and Wales and Northern Ireland, grievous bodily harm within the meaning of the Offences Against the Person Act 1861, see section 184(3).
